source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("legend=False", "legend=True")
source = source.replace("plt.gca().set_xlim(-0.5, 2.28125)", "plt.gca().set_xlim(-0.5, 2.5)")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
plt.close("all")
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gca()
print("x limits:", ax.get_xlim())
print("y limits:", ax.get_ylim())
print("Legend labels:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
bounds = [(p.get_path().vertices[:, 0].min(), p.get_path().vertices[:, 0].max())
          for p in ax.patches if len(p.get_path().vertices) == 6]
print("Box horizontal bounds:", bounds)
assert ax.get_xlim() == (-0.5, 2.5)
assert [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()] == list(df.columns[3:])
